card.name: Capital F starting a name
card.fires_on: The letter F as the start of a capitalized word or name, such as Führer, Friedrich, FLEGT, FDP or FRS. It also fires on a bracket or full stop right after a name.

modes.label: Initial F of a name or acronym
modes.description: A lone F or f begins a proper name, German term or acronym.
modes.example: Free Democratic Party The Free Democratic Party (Freie Demokratische Partei--<<F>>DP) is much smaller than the CD

modes.label: Punctuation after a name
modes.description: A bracket or full stop follows a person's or work's name, where a new item begins.
modes.example: Rock musician Lee Ranaldo<< (>>Sonic Youth) is 57

card.writes: It promotes words like center and tower and suppresses odd rare tokens, so there is no clear link to the F pattern.
card.plain: It fires when a capital F opens a name or acronym, such as Friedrich or FDP.
